description: CLI coding agents - native installers and npm globals.
demo_beat: step 1 - Claude Code and Codex CLI rows
why: file >= 2 because Claude Code shows up twice under enumeration: the ~/.local/bin/ shim and the ~/.claude/ state dotdir. Both come from product-free globs now, which is the point -- the old query named the file 'claude' outright. npm >= 4 covers the four npm globals; it is a floor rather than an equality because npm installs each package's dependencies globally too and the row count is not ours to predict. Pi comes from its own installer, which writes ~/.pi and no npm global; forbid_rows holds both its npm names absent, so ~/.pi is its only witness here.
